# Life Event

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LifeEvent`](gmeow-LifeEvent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LifeEvent>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

An event in the life of a person or family — a birth, death, marriage, christening, name change, and so on — to which sources and confidence can be attached. A thin, person-scoped phase of [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md) (NOT a type taxonomy): the specific kind is a [`gmeow:eventType`](../properties/gmeow-eventType.md) value ([`gmeow:eventTypeBirth`](../individuals/gmeow-eventTypeBirth.md), …). The seam joining the names module to the event spine: [`gmeow:conferredByEvent`](../properties/gmeow-conferredByEvent.md) ranges over it.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:LifeEvent`](gmeow-LifeEvent.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
